text:
Loreta Virginia Smith Hickey, a longtime resident of Plano, Texas, passed away peacefully on March 25, 2026, at the age of 98, according to an announcement from Ted Dickey Funeral Home. Her passing marks the complete of a life spanning nearly a century, filled with personal history and witnessed significant changes in the world around her. The news of her avis de décès—a French term for death notice—has prompted an outpouring of remembrance from the Plano community and beyond.
Born on July 6, 1927, Loreta Hickey lived through the Great Depression, World War II and the rapid technological advancements of the late 20th and early 21st centuries. Details regarding her early life, family, and career are currently limited in publicly available information, but her longevity speaks to a life lived with resilience and adaptability. The family has requested privacy during this time of mourning, and further biographical details are expected to be released in the coming days. This obituary serves as a formal notification of her death and provides initial information for those wishing to express their condolences.
The passing of individuals approaching a century of life often serves as a poignant reminder of generational shifts and the importance of preserving personal histories. Understanding the context of Loreta Hickey’s life—the historical events she lived through, the societal changes she witnessed—offers a unique perspective on the evolution of Plano, Texas, and the nation as a whole. The term “avis de décès,” while originating in French legal tradition, is increasingly used in English-speaking contexts to denote a formal death announcement, often including details about funeral arrangements and memorial services. The use of this term reflects a growing global interconnectedness and the sharing of cultural practices.
A Life in Plano, Texas
While specific details about Loreta Hickey’s involvement in the Plano community are still emerging, her long residency suggests a deep connection to the city’s growth and development. Plano, a suburb north of Dallas, has experienced significant population growth in recent decades, transforming from a small agricultural town to a thriving economic hub. According to the City of Plano’s official demographics page, the population has increased from approximately 68,000 in 1990 to over 288,000 in 2023. Someone who lived in Plano for nearly eight decades would have witnessed this transformation firsthand.
Ted Dickey Funeral Home, the organization handling the arrangements, has been a fixture in the Plano area for many years, providing support to families during times of loss. The funeral home’s website offers information about services, pre-planning options, and grief resources. The choice of Ted Dickey Funeral Home suggests a desire for a traditional and respectful memorial service within the community. Further details regarding the service will be released by the family through the funeral home.
Understanding the Significance of an Avis de Décès
The practice of publishing an avis de décès dates back to French legal tradition, originally serving as a public notice of a death to protect the deceased’s estate. Over time, it evolved into a more general announcement of a death, often including biographical information and details about funeral arrangements. While the legal implications have diminished, the practice remains common in many countries, including France, Canada, and increasingly in the United States. The use of the term itself signifies a formal and respectful acknowledgment of the passing.
In the digital age, avis de décès are often published online, allowing for wider dissemination of information and providing a platform for condolences and memories to be shared. Websites like Legacy.com and funeral home websites serve as central repositories for these announcements, making it easier for friends and family to stay informed and connected. The online format also allows for the inclusion of photos, videos, and other multimedia elements, enriching the memorial experience.

The funeral home’s website (https://www.dignitymemorial.com/obituaries/plano-tx/ted-dickey-funeral-home/loreta-hickey) will be the primary source of information regarding service dates, times, and locations. Those wishing to express their condolences are encouraged to visit the website or contact the funeral home directly.
The family has requested privacy at this time, and any inquiries should be directed to Ted Dickey Funeral Home. It is anticipated that a more comprehensive obituary, including details about Loreta Hickey’s life, family, and accomplishments, will be published in the coming days. The Plano community mourns the loss of a long-time resident and extends its sympathy to her loved ones.
The next update from Ted Dickey Funeral Home is expected within the next 48-72 hours, providing details regarding the memorial service.
